question: Which of the following mainly causes the depletion of the ozone layer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chlorofluorocarbons.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chlorofluorocarbons **are a major cause of the** depletion of the ozone layer.**
 
• These** halocarbons** are used as** refrigerants, solvents, propellants, and foam-blowing agents.**
 
• The molecules of** chlorofluorocarbons** in the stratosphere are **broken down by ultraviolet radiations** and release **chlorine** atoms. These atoms react with ozone and destroy it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Ozone layer** reduces harmful** UV radiation **reaching the Earth's surface.
 
• The **Ozone layer **is present in Earth’s atmosphere (15 - 35 km above Earth) in the lower portion of the** stratosphere **and has relatively high concentrations of ozone (O3).
 
• **Ozone layer** depletion is the gradual** thinning of the earth’s ozone layer** present in the upper atmosphere. 
 
• **World Ozone Day** is observed on **September 16 **every year to spread awareness among people about the depletion of the Ozone Layer.
